title.zh: 用 GitHub Pages 从零搭个人主页
title.en: Building a personal site on GitHub Pages

excerpt.zh: 从仓库结构到自定义域名，把踩过的坑一次写清楚。
excerpt.en: From repo layout to a custom domain — every pitfall written down once.

title.zh: 免费额度到底能撑多久
title.en: How long do free tiers really last

excerpt.zh: 整理了大半年用过的免费服务，哪些还活着、哪些已经不能薅了。
excerpt.en: Half a year of free services: which ones survive and which quietly closed.

title.zh: 纯 CSS 实现卡片阴影与悬浮感
title.en: Card shadows and lift with pure CSS

excerpt.zh: 不用框架，用 box-shadow 和 transform 做出有手感的界面。
excerpt.en: No framework needed: box-shadow and transform give the interface real feel.

title.zh: 把笔记从云端搬回本地
title.en: Moving notes back to local storage

excerpt.zh: 本地优先的笔记方案实践，以及迁移时要注意的格式问题。
excerpt.en: Hands-on with a local-first note workflow, plus the format issues migration raises.

title.zh: 把导航栏做成可复用的组件
title.en: Turning the navbar into a reusable component

excerpt.zh: 单页站点的导航最容易越写越乱，拆成数据驱动后清爽很多。
excerpt.en: Navigation on a single-page site gets messy fast; data-driving it made it clean again.

title.zh: 暗色主题不是把颜色反过来
title.en: Dark mode is not inverted colours

excerpt.zh: 对比度、边界和阴影在暗色下都要重新调，直接反转只会更难读。
excerpt.en: Contrast, borders and shadows all need rework — a naive inversion just gets harder to read.
